name: Lubricating oils (petroleum), C20-35, solvent-extd., dewaxed, hydrogenated; Baseoil - unspecified; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons obtained by solvent extraction and hydrogenation of atmospheric distillation residues. It consists predominantly of hydrocarbons having carbon numbers predominantly in the range of C20 through C35 and produces a finished oil with a viscosity in the order of 37cSt to 44cSt at 40 °C (104 °F).]
